address: 1F, JW Marriott, 183 Jalan Bukit Bintang, Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur, 55100, Malaysia
bio: In business since 1999, the restaurant was updated in 2021 and now sports a bright, modern interior. The veteran chef traditionally crafts Shanghainese classics, and his xiao long bao is a must-try – soupy pork filling enrobed in paper-thin, meticulously pleated skin. Stir-fried flat glass noodles with shredded pork and preserved vegetable boasts remarkable wok hei, and the salted potherb mustard greens impart briny umami....
